You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.

You will uphold professional and technical standards, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. jobs.title: BRIM Technical Architect
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:
   

  

 Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross\-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade\-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.
   

  

 Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.
   

  

 Main missions:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross\-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI\-CA) within the O2C flow
* Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level.
* Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non\-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event\-based integration.
* Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade\-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds.
* Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade\-offs and platform limitations before build starts.
* Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options.


 Tasks:
   

  

* Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level.
* Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event\-driven, API\-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation.
* Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross\-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build.
* Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade\-safe.
* Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build\-vs\-standard trade\-offs that shape future product decisions."
* Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward\-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements.
* Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing.
* Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA.
* Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward\-compatible.
* Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads.
* Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture\-level technical issues.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* 8\+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end\-to\-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations.
* Strong cross\-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns.
* Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level.
* Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non\-SAP systems.
* Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to.
* Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks.
* Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams.
* Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions.
* Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade\-offs legible to non\-architects.


 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!
   

  

 Who We Are:
   

  

 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
   

  

 At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward\-thinking environment.

 The role requires a strong understanding of SAP IS\-U business processes, BPEM framework, exception monitoring, case management, prioritization, and integration with key IS\-U processes such as Billing, Invoicing, Meter Reading, Device Management, Customer Service, Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA), and Move\-In/Move\-Out.

 Strong experience translating business requirements into SAP IS\-U functional solutions.
 



 Experience preparing functional specifications and working with technical development teams.

 Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

 Preferred Skills

 Familiarity with SAP IS\-U master data and technical objects.
 



 Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
 



 Experience coordinating with offshore/onshore functional and technical teams.
 



 Strong experience in production support and incident management.
 



 BPEM Functional Expertise
 



  
 



 The ideal consultant should be able to demonstrate practical knowledge of:

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant** 




**Location: New York** 




  





**Position Overview**




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on experience across SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), Subscription Order Management (SOM), and FI\-CA.
 



 The ideal candidate will have experience working with usage/event data generated by upstream SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) and will be responsible for understanding and ingesting that data, defining the required downstream processing, and supporting the creation and processing of BITs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work as a functional SME across the SAP BRIM landscape, with a focus on CI, SOM, and FICA.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into functional BRIM solutions.
* Analyze event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM). Understand the structure, content, and business meaning of CM output data and determine how it should be processed within BRIM.
* Define the required mappings and transformations from incoming usage/event data into BITs. Ensure the appropriate BITs are created from the incoming usage/event data and are available for downstream processing.
* Work with technical teams to ingest and validate data received from CM.
* Support the end\-to\-end flow from CM output → data ingestion → BIT creation → Billing/Invoicing → FI\-CA.
* Support FI\-CA processes including account determination, postings, invoicing, payments, and receivables.
* Troubleshoot functional issues by tracing data across the BRIM landscape and identifying where processing or data discrepancies occur.
* Work closely with developers and integration teams on data mappings, interfaces, transformations, and BRIM integrations.
* Create functional specifications, mapping documents, and business process documentation.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production issue resolution.
* Perform end\-to\-end reconciliation to ensure that incoming usage data results in the expected charging, billing, and financial postings.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional issues and validate expected outcomes.



  





**Required Experience:**



* 10\+ years SAP BRIM functional experience/Multiple Hands\-on BRIM Projects
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP CI, SOM, and FI\-CA.
* Experience working with event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with technical teams to implement integrations and data transformations.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working with subscription products would be preferred.

jobs.title: MI Reporting Engineer – Billing Transformation
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **MI / Reporting Engineer – Billing Transformation** to design, develop, and maintain robust **Management Information (MI)**, operational reporting, dashboards, and analytics solutions supporting a large\-scale **Billing Transformation programme**.

The role requires strong expertise in **reporting technologies, Snowflake, Power BI, SQL, billing processes, Order\-to\-Cash lifecycle, and data modelling**. The ideal candidate will deliver accurate, timely, and trusted insights across billing operations, revenue, invoicing, collections, disputes, and transformation KPIs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Management Information \& Reporting**

* Design, develop, and maintain reporting solutions that provide visibility into Billing Transformation initiatives and operational performance.
* Build reports and dashboards covering:
* Billing and invoicing operations
* Revenue and billing accuracy
* Customer billing lifecycle
* Billing exceptions and disputes
* Collections and receivables performance
* Service and product billing trends
* Transformation programme progress and KPI tracking
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and convert them into scalable reporting solutions.
* Develop executive\-level and operational dashboards to support strategic and tactical decision\-making.
* Publish and manage governed datasets to enable self\-service analytics for Finance and Billing Operations teams.

**Business Intelligence \& Visualisation**

* Develop and maintain interactive **Power BI dashboards**, reports, and scorecards.
* Create visual analytics covering:
* Billing accuracy
* Invoice processing performance
* Revenue trends
* Billing exceptions and disputes
* Collections effectiveness
* Customer billing behaviour
* Ensure dashboards are user\-friendly, performant, accessible, and aligned to business needs.
* Improve reporting usability through effective layout, drilldowns, filters, KPIs, and storytelling.

**Data Modelling \& Analytics**

* Work with **Snowflake** and cloud\-based data warehouse environments to support reporting and analytics needs.
* Build, optimize, and maintain SQL queries, views, datasets, and reporting layers.
* Support data modelling for billing, revenue, invoicing, collections, and reconciliation reporting.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, lineage, and governance across MI/reporting outputs.
* Perform analysis to identify trends, exceptions, operational bottlenecks, and performance insights.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Finance, Billing Operations, Transformation, Technology, and Data teams.
* Translate business reporting needs into clear technical specifications.
* Present reporting outputs, insights, and recommendations to business and leadership stakeholders.
* Support ongoing enhancements based on feedback, changing business needs, and transformation priorities.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in **Management Information (MI), Reporting, and Business Intelligence** delivery.
* Hands\-on experience with **Power BI** dashboard and report development.
* Strong experience working with **Snowflake** and cloud\-based data warehousing platforms.
* Advanced **SQL development** and query optimization skills.
* Strong understanding of **data modelling**, reporting layers, governed datasets, and dashboard performance optimization.
* Ability to design scalable reporting solutions for enterprise transformation programmes.

**Functional / Domain Skills**

* Experience supporting one or more of the following:
* Billing Transformation
* Revenue Management
* Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)
* Invoicing
* Finance Transformation
* Billing Operations
* Solid understanding of billing processes including:
* Invoice generation
* Billing accuracy
* Receivables
* Collections
* Reconciliation
* Billing exceptions and disputes
* Ability to understand complex billing and finance data flows and translate them into meaningful reports and dashboards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on large\-scale **Billing Transformation**, **ERP Transformation**, or **Finance Modernisation** programmes.
* Knowledge of billing platforms such as:
* Salesforce Billing
* SAP BRIM
* Oracle Billing
* Zuora
* Similar enterprise billing platforms
* Understanding of **Revenue Recognition** and broader **Order\-to\-Cash** processes.
* Experience in financial services, risk, information services, technology, SaaS, or subscription\-based business environments.
* Familiarity with data cataloguing and governance tools such as:
* Collibra
* Alation
* Microsoft Purview

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with both business and technical teams.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple reporting priorities.
* Comfortable working in transformation environments with evolving requirements.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹14,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Engineer - Convergent Mediation (CM)
jobs.description:
The Business Applications team at Zoox is responsible for building the foundation that connects our autonomous vehicle technology with a seamless customer experience. Our team thrives on collaboration, open problem\-solving, and supportive risk\-taking.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to expand your technical horizons across our billing and financial ecosystem while taking direct ownership of a high\-volume, high\-transaction mediation layer. We are looking for an individual who loves to learn, values data accuracy, and is excited to see their designs directly support autonomous fleet operations.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead the design and architecture of SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) frameworks to process usage, events, and transactional data.
* Configure and customize mediation pipelines, transformation rules, enrichment, and routing logic.
* Design end\-to\-end data flows between upstream source systems, Convergent Charging (CC), and downstream BRIM components.
* Optimize mediation performance to ensure accurate, low\-latency transaction processing and fault tolerance.
* Establish monitoring dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and reconciliation frameworks to ensure financial compliance and data integrity.
* Collaborate closely with finance, product, engineering, and external vendors to provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience delivering end\-to\-end SAP BRIM implementations with a specific focus on Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Hands\-on proficiency configuring mediation flows, transformations, and integrations with SAP CC, CI, FICA, or external APIs.
* Deep understanding of event\-based architectures and processing large transactional data volumes.
* Ability to operate effectively at both a high\-level structural architecture phase and a hands\-on individual contributor level.
* Effective communication skills with a proven track record of collaborating across cross\-functional technical and business teams.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience in mobility, ride\-hailing, telecom, or subscription\-based business models.
* Familiarity with real\-time streaming technologies (such as Kafka), modern data pipelines, or cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong understanding of revenue assurance and financial reconciliation processes.


 $198,000 \- $237,000 a year
   

  

**Base Salary Range**
 There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights.  Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

 Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. **Job Description**
 As an SAP Order Management Consultant specializing in S/4 HANA, you will be responsible for providing expertise in configuring, implementing, and optimizing the Order Management module within SAP S/4 HANA. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective solutions within the SAP ecosystem. Your role will involve configuring and customizing SAP systems, conducting workshops, providing guidance on best practices, and ensuring successful delivery of projects.
   

  

 You will report to our Sr IT Director and work out of our Charlotte, NC or Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid basis. Note: for the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M\-F.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Integration: Collaborate with integration teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP Order Management and other SAP modules (such as Sales, Logistics, Finance) and external systems.
* Testing: Develop and execute test scripts to ensure the configured solutions meet business requirements and perform as expected.
* Training and Documentation: Provide training to end\-users on new processes and functionalities. Create documentation including user manuals, configuration guides, and training materials.
* Support and Maintenance: Provide ongoing support and maintenance for SAP Order Management solutions, including troubleshooting issues, applying patches, and implementing enhancements.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization within SAP Order Management, leveraging new features and functionalities of SAP S/4 HANA.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, developers, and other consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
